sentences.text: Edilm is a cohort company whose country is recorded as FI, but the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record has two programme-entry entries from eitfood.eu, dated 2025-06-30 and 2024 with the year only, both at low confidence.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
No funding, patent or contract record is on file, so every readiness level is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist, and the company's registered name should be found so its Finnish register data can be read.
